factual_methodology.summary: Verified 9 primary institutional URLs and their reference dates, distinguished observed September prices from IMF/ECB conditional forecasts; qualified fiscal propagation rather than claiming causal debt events.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: New sovereign refinancing, debt-maturity and liquidity-risk theme distinct from 17 October refined-product scarcity; no editorial or production meta-language.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Two paired quantitative charts on World Bank commodity price indices and ECB growth scenarios; three evidence tables, one flow with three transmission chains and one five-region qualitative map in each locale.

research_depth.summary: Fiscal maturity structure, inflation spillover, rate-setting mechanisms, nonbank financial amplifiers, geographic distribution and three falsifiable scenarios; bilingual sections and visual parity.

evidence_traceability.summary: Nine exact primary-source institutional URLs repeated in both languages across 6 official hosts; each substantive number dated and distinguished from inference.

counterfactual_review.summary: Includes orderly normalization, slow fiscal deterioration and forced-deleveraging alternatives, along with explicit stress and counter-evidence indicators.

contrary_evidence: Long debt maturity delays pass-through from current sovereign yields to budget interest expense.
Declining energy prices or stable demand at auctions can undermine an inflation-refinancing stress scenario.
Commodity exporters with unimpeded shipments may gain revenues; the benefit is not uniform across countries or petroleum products.
Global figures cannot determine national debt sustainability without fiscal and currency detail.
limitations: No calibrated country-specific interest-cost or debt-default probability.
ECB severe scenario is an illustrative model outcome rather than a probable forecast.
Fiscal commentary and commodity observations describe different cutoff dates and should not be treated as synchronized observations.
No Sunday bond closing yields or intraday prices asserted.
notes: Documentary methodological and bilingual review against institutionally verified primary releases; editorial review is internal rather than external peer review.
